vencieron: vençer — they won, defeated (preterite 3rd pl.; = vencieron)
lidiaran: lidiar — they had fought, they fought (-ra form 3rd pl., from the Latin pluperfect in -(av)erant, keeping its old pluperfect value; = habían lidiado, lidiaron; modern lidiaran is imperfect subjunctive)
ondrados: ondrar — honored, esteemed (past part. masc. pl.; = honrados)
prisiessen: prender — (that) they take (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., strong stem pris-; prender so derecho 'to take one's due'; = prendiesen, tomasen)
cadierónle: caer + le — they fell to him, came to him as his share (preterite 3rd pl. cadieron, the old -d- form, + enclitic le 'to him'; = le cayeron)
serién: seer — they would be (conditional 3rd pl., imperfect-type ending -ién; = serían)
minguado: minguar — lacking, in want (past part. masc. sg.; 'diminished, reduced'; = menguado)
arranco: arrancar — I rout, I win (present 1st sg.; arrancar las lides 'to win battles', arrancar 'to pull out, uproot' hence 'to rout'; = arranco)
abrám: aver — they will have (future 3rd pl., spelled with b and final -m; abrám de mi salto 'they will have (suffer) my attack', Pidal 'que yo les asalte'; = habrán)
piensso: pensar — I think, I intend (present 1st sg., spelled with ss; = pienso)
paguen: pagar — (that) they pay (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = paguen)
ovier: aver — I/he shall have (future subjunctive 1st or 3rd sg., final -e dropped, = oviere; a qui yo ovier sabor 'to whomever I please', Pidal 'a quien yo quisiere'; = hubiere)
valía: valía — worth, value (fem. noun; valía de çinco mill marcos 'worth five thousand marks'; = valía, valor)
crió: criar — he raised, brought up, trained (preterite 3rd sg.; = crió)
recibiólos: recebir + los — he received them (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic los; = los recibió)
cuñados: cuñado — kinsman by marriage, in-law (masc. pl.; Pidal: in general 'pariente por afinidad', not only 'brother-in-law', so said to the husbands of one's cousins; = parientes políticos, cuñados)
valemos: valer — we are worth (present 1st pl.; = valemos)
abraçen: abraçar — (let) them embrace (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive; = abracen)
abredes: aver — you will have (future 2nd pl., contracted from avredes; = habréis)
honor: honor — honour (spelled with h-; in the sense of ondra 'honour', not onor 'estate, lordship'; = honor, honra)
lidiado: lidiar — fought (past part.; aver + participle, avemos lidiado 'we have fought'; = lidiado)
matamos: matar — we killed (preterite 1st pl., same form as the present; = matamos)
traydor: traidor — traitor (= traidor, old spelling traydor)
provado: provar — proven, tried and found (past part. as adjective; traydor provado 'proven traitor'; = probado)
pensad: pensar — think, see to (imperative 2nd pl.; pensar de 'to attend to, take care of', Pidal 'cuidaos de'; = pensad, ocupaos de)
tenémoslo: tener + lo — we have it, we hold it (present 1st pl. tenemos + enclitic lo; = lo tenemos)
saluo: salvo — safe, in safety (u spelling for v; en saluo 'in safekeeping'; = salvo)
sediense: seer + se — they were sitting, they were (imperfect 3rd pl. sedien, unaccented as printed, + enclitic se; with a gerund, 'were (doing)'; = estaban sentados, se estaban)
lidiara: lidiar — he had fought, he fought (-ra form 3rd sg., from the Latin pluperfect in -(av)erat, keeping its old pluperfect value; quien lidiara mejor 'who had fought best'; = había lidiado, lidió; modern lidiara is imperfect subjunctive)
juegos: juego — jest, sport, game (masc. pl.; = juegos)
levantando: levantar — raising, setting up (gerund; ir + gerund ivan levantando 'were going on raising'; = levantando)
escarmentando: escarmentar — chastising, punishing, teaching a hard lesson (gerund; of mockery that stings; = escarmentando)
conssejaron: consejar — they took counsel, they advised (preterite 3rd pl., ss spelling; reflexive se conssejaron 'they took counsel together'; = aconsejaron, se aconsejaron)
veramientre: veramientre — truly, really (adverb from vera 'true' + -mientre, the old form of -mente; = verdaderamente)
fáblaron: fablar — they spoke (preterite 3rd pl., f- for h-; = hablaron)
detardamos: detardar — we delay, we linger (present 1st pl.; = tardamos, nos demoramos)

__broaden__.iffantes: infante — child, young child (pl., spelt with ff; = niños); also a young man of noble birth · also iffantes — the infantes of Carrión, young noblemen, sons of a noble house (estos iffantes amos 'these two infantes'; = infantes)
__broaden__.elas: e + las — and the (e 'and' + fem. pl. article las; elas siellas 'and the saddles'; = y las) · also elas — the (fem. pl.), perhaps the archaic full article (= las; cf. ela) rather than e + las: elas noches e los días 'always, continually' (Pidal 'siempre, continuamente'); the analysis is uncertain
__broaden__.salto: salto — leap, jump · also dash, sally (dar salto 'to make a sortie'; non osa ninguno dar salto a la çaga 'none dares to dash at the rearguard') · also salto — assault, sudden attack (de mi salto, Pidal 'que yo les asalte'; = asalto)
__broaden__.contado: contar — renowned, esteemed (past part. used as a standing epithet of the Campeador) · also of others: un Burgalés contado, 'a renowned man of Burgos' (Martín Antolínez) · also contado — counted, reckoned out (plain past part. of contar; so derecho contado 'his due share, counted out'; = contado)
__broaden__.sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure' · also por sabor de 'out of a wish to please, for the sake of' (por sabor de mio Çid 'to please the Cid') · also por sabor que — 'out of the desire (that)' (por sabor que avía de algún moro matare 'out of the longing I had to kill some Moor') · also aver sabor — to long for, to wish (lo que avía sabor 'what I longed for'; a qui yo ovier sabor 'to whomever I please', Pidal 'quisiere')
__broaden__.mayor: mayor — larger, greater (aquella mayor az 'that greatest line'; = mayor) · also Mayor — part of the place name Mont Mayor, Montemayor (the Portuguese town, Pidal) · also la mayor — 'the great', standing epithet of Valencia (Valençia la mayor)
__broaden__.tienen: tener — they have, hold, carry (present 3rd pl.; todas tienen pendones 'all carry pennons'; = tienen) · also tenerse por — to count oneself (ques tienen por casadas 'who count themselves married'; = se tienen por) · also tener por — to hold (someone) to be (muchos tienen por ricos 'many hold (them) rich'; = tener por)
